sentences: The vendor's failure analysis report stated that 'the mechanical seal failure was caused by excessive shaft runout exceeding 0.08 mm TIR,' but the plant's independent metallurgical review concluded that the runout itself had been induced by a misaligned bearing housing installed during the previous outage maintenance campaign.

The plant review further noted that the bearing housing misalignment had gone undetected because the post-installation alignment verification step had been omitted from the maintenance procedure used during that outage.

The two causal chains — vendor's (runout → seal failure) and plant's (misaligned housing → runout → seal failure) — yielded different corrective actions, with the vendor recommending seal replacement and the plant requiring bearing housing realignment as the primary corrective measure.

The original log attribution of 'cause unknown' had delayed corrective action by approximately four hours, during which the pump remained unavailable and the plant operated with reduced primary coolant flow margin.

sentences: The regulatory inspection report cited the condition report narrative, which stated: 'The pressuriser level decrease was attributed to inadvertent opening of the letdown isolation valve,' and concluded that this direct cause was itself a consequence of an inadequate human factors design of the valve control panel, where the letdown and charging valve actuator switches were positioned adjacently without tactile differentiation.

The regulator's finding therefore identified two distinct causal levels: the immediate cause documented in the plant's own condition report, and a latent organisational cause not captured in the original plant investigation.
The plant's corrective action programme had addressed only the immediate cause, leaving the latent panel design deficiency unresolved and creating continued vulnerability to the same class of error.

sentences: The outage planning document noted: 'Per Engineering Change EC-2024-0447, the reactor coolant pump seal configuration change is required to address the industry operating experience documented in NRC Information Notice 2023-05, which identified seal degradation as the leading cause of unplanned primary system leakage events at pressurised water reactors.'

The work order was therefore generated not in response to any observed plant-specific failure, but as a preventive measure triggered by the regulatory information notice's identification of a generic industry causal pattern.
The seal configuration change was completed successfully, and no seal-related leakage events have been recorded at this plant in the twenty-two months following implementation.

annotation_notes: Four-level nested document reference: work order → engineering change → NRC notice → industry event data. The innermost causal claim is generic and not plant-specific. Models must correctly scope the causal claim to its original context.

sentences: The industry operating experience review for this event identified a comparable event at another plant where the post-event report concluded: 'The spurious safety injection actuation was caused by a combination of high containment humidity and degraded cable insulation on the containment pressure transmitter signal cable, which together produced a common-mode noise signal indistinguishable from a genuine high-pressure signal.'

The reviewing engineer noted that the local plant's containment humidity control system had been operating at the upper end of its control band for the preceding six months, suggesting that the same causal mechanism could be applicable to the current event under investigation.

However, the local plant investigation ultimately attributed the actuation to a different root cause: a software configuration error in the digital signal processing module introduced during the most recent instrumentation system upgrade.

sentences: The corrective action programme trend report noted that three separate condition reports over the preceding twelve months had each independently cited 'inadequate procedure adherence' as the root cause of primary coolant chemistry deviations.

The trend report's framing of the root cause as a human performance issue had therefore obscured the underlying programmatic cause, which the common cause analysis identified as a procedure adequacy deficiency rather than an individual behaviour problem.

text: The root cause evaluation identified the following contributing causes to the primary boundary leakage event described in Section 3.1: (1) inadequate torque specification in maintenance procedure MP-4421 revision 7, which permitted under-torquing of the reactor coolant pump mechanical seal gland bolts by up to 15% below the manufacturer's minimum value; (2) absence of a post-maintenance hydrostatic leak test in the approved test procedure, which would have detected the under-torqued condition before reactor restart; (3) shift supervisor approval of the maintenance package without independent verification of the torque values recorded in the maintenance traveller. Each of these three factors contributed independently and cumulatively to the leakage event, and the removal of any single factor would not alone have prevented the outcome.

sentences: The five-year corrective action programme trend analysis identified the following equipment failure modes as the leading causes of unplanned reactor trips over the review period, ranked by frequency: (1) feedwater control system instrumentation failures — 9 trips; (2) main turbine protection system spurious actuations — 6 trips; (3) reactor protection system channel calibration drift — 4 trips; (4) emergency diesel generator start failures — 3 trips; (5) primary coolant pump seal degradation events — 2 trips.

The analysis concluded that instrumentation reliability improvements targeting items 1 and 3 would address 54% of the historical trip frequency, making the instrumentation ageing management programme the highest-priority corrective action area.

sentences: The corrective maintenance history for valve HV-2341 over the preceding three years is as follows: 2022-03: actuator spring replaced — cause: fatigue fracture after 8 years service; 2022-11: packing replaced — cause: excessive leakoff due to packing set compression beyond design limit; 2023-07: position transmitter replaced — cause: moisture ingress through degraded conduit seal; 2024-02: full valve body replacement — cause: body wall pitting corrosion from external condensate exposure.

The recurrence of valve-related failures at an average interval of seven months over the review period indicates a systemic vulnerability in the valve's operating environment rather than isolated component deficiencies, suggesting that the root cause of the recurring maintenance demand is the persistently high humidity in the valve gallery rather than any individual component failure mode.

annotation_notes: Classic VP coordination ellipsis: 'caused [NP1 to V1] and [NP2 to V2]'. Both effects share the single cause span and the causative verb. Span-based extractors that look for subject-verb-object triples will find only one effect.

sentences: The loss of instrument air pressure caused the containment ventilation dampers to fail closed, the main steam isolation valves to fail open, and the pressuriser spray valve to fail in its last position.

Each effect involves a different component with a different failure direction (closed/open/last position). A model extracting only the first effect will miss two-thirds of the causal content.

The 73% attribution to the March transient was considered sufficient to classify it as the most probable cause for corrective action prioritisation purposes, while acknowledging that a definitive attribution was not possible without destructive examination of the affected weld.

sentences: The stress corrosion cracking susceptibility assessment assigned a low-to-moderate likelihood to the hypothesis that the observed intergranular attack was caused by polythionic acid stress corrosion cracking during the shutdown period, noting that the required sulphur-containing species would need to have been present in the steam generator secondary water at concentrations not previously detected in routine chemistry sampling.

A definitive discrimination between the two mechanisms requires isotopic analysis of the crack surface chemistry, which has been submitted to the vendor laboratory with results expected within eight weeks.

annotation_notes: 'Cannot be excluded' is a negative epistemic hedge — it does not assert the causal link but refuses to deny it. This is weaker than 'is possible' and requires a specific epistemic label. The preferred hypothesis uses 'most parsimonious' rather than any causal connective.

sentences: Whether the diesel generator starting failure was primarily caused by the fuel injector fouling or by the governor response delay remains unclear from the available diagnostic data.
Both mechanisms are plausible given the observed symptom profile, and the relative contribution of each cannot be quantified without a controlled test that isolates each variable independently.
The work order therefore specifies replacement of both the injectors and the governor module as a conservative corrective measure, accepting that the true primary cause may remain unconfirmed.

cause.span: fuel injector fouling

effect.span: diesel generator starting failure

cause.span: governor response delay

effect.span: diesel generator starting failure

annotation_notes: 'Whether X or Y caused Z remains unclear' — a polar question frame around a causal relation. Both causes are simultaneously asserted as plausible but unranked. The 'Whether...or' construction is rarely handled by causal extractors trained on declarative sentences.

sentences: Initial shift log entries from the first four hours of the event attributed the rising containment pressure to normal outgassing of dissolved gases from the primary coolant following the reactor trip.

Subsequent chemistry analysis of the containment atmosphere samples collected at two-hour intervals showed noble gas isotopic ratios inconsistent with the normal outgassing hypothesis and more consistent with a primary coolant leak source.

The root cause determination board ultimately concluded that the containment pressure rise had been caused by steam and primary coolant leakage through a ruptured bellows seal on the reactor coolant pump vent line, and explicitly rejected the initial outgassing hypothesis as inconsistent with the isotopic evidence.

cause.span: normal outgassing of dissolved gases from the primary coolant following the reactor trip

effect.span: rising containment pressure

cause.span: steam and primary coolant leakage through a ruptured bellows seal on the reactor coolant pump vent line

effect.span: containment pressure rise

annotation_notes: Three epistemic stages: initial attribution (S1, rejected), intermediate evidence (S2, redirects), final confirmed cause (S3). Models must track the validity status of each causal claim across discourse time and extract only the final confirmed relation.

sentences: The first engineering assessment concluded that the elevated vibration on the circulating water pump was caused by cavitation due to low suction head during the low river level conditions.
This assessment led to an increase in the suction header pressure by reducing throttling on the supply valves, but the vibration persisted at the same amplitude after the adjustment.

Reanalysis of the vibration spectrum after the failed corrective action identified a mechanical resonance at 47.3 Hz consistent with impeller natural frequency excitation rather than hydraulic cavitation, and the root cause was reclassified as impeller damage causing imbalance.

cause.span: cavitation due to low suction head during the low river level conditions

effect.span: elevated vibration on the circulating water pump

cause.span: impeller damage causing imbalance

effect.span: elevated vibration on the circulating water pump

annotation_notes: The failed corrective action (S2) provides the evidence that disproves the first causal hypothesis. S3 introduces the correct cause using 'reclassified as' — an epistemic reclassification verb rather than a standard causal connective. Models must use the failed-correction evidence to invalidate R1.

sentences: The shift team's immediate post-trip assessment identified the reactor trip as having been initiated by a genuine high neutron flux condition resulting from inadvertent control rod withdrawal.

Review of the sequence of events recorder data two hours later revised this assessment, showing that the neutron flux signal had not in fact exceeded the trip setpoint and that the trip had been initiated by a spurious electrical signal.

The final root cause evaluation determined that the spurious signal had originated from a failing solder joint on the trip logic printed circuit board, which intermittently connected the trip output to a stray voltage source on the chassis ground plane.

cause.span: inadvertent control rod withdrawal

effect.span: reactor trip

cause.span: spurious electrical signal

effect.span: trip had been initiated

sentences: Early in the investigation, the team hypothesised that the primary coolant temperature deviation was caused by a stuck-open pressuriser heater that had failed to de-energise on the temperature controller output signal.
This hypothesis was tested by manually de-energising all pressuriser heaters, but the temperature deviation persisted, eliminating the heater failure theory.

Further investigation identified that a bypass line isolation valve had been left partially open, allowing a small continuous flow of hotter primary coolant from a adjacent loop to mix with the local coolant, producing the measured temperature anomaly.

sentences: The initial condition report attributed the abnormal noise from the feedwater pump to cavitation, based on the characteristic low-frequency rumble and the observation that suction pressure had been near its lower alarm setpoint.

However, a detailed vibration analysis performed forty-eight hours later showed that the frequency spectrum was not consistent with cavitation but instead showed a high-frequency impulsive signature characteristic of bearing spalling.

Subsequent disassembly confirmed severe spalling on the inner race of the pump drive-end bearing, caused by a brinelling event that had occurred when the pump had been subjected to an abnormal hydraulic shock load during a previous valve slam event.

sentences: The reactor coolant pump seal leakoff rate increased from 1.2 to 3.8 litres per hour at approximately the same time as the primary coolant temperature rose by 4 °C during the load change manoeuvre.

The chronological proximity of the two changes made it difficult to determine from the available data whether the elevated temperature had softened the seal material and increased leakoff, or whether the increased leakoff had altered the local heat balance and contributed to the temperature rise.
Both mechanisms are thermodynamically plausible, and discrimination between them required detailed seal thermal modelling that was completed over the subsequent three weeks.

cause.span: primary coolant temperature rose by 4 °C during the load change manoeuvre

effect.span: reactor coolant pump seal leakoff rate increased from 1.2 to 3.8 litres per hour

causal_relations.causal_connective: at approximately the same time as

annotation_notes: Both causal directions are explicitly stated in S2 as equally plausible. The temporal connective 'at approximately the same time as' is not a causal connective but models treating temporal co-occurrence as causation will extract a false relation. Both R1 and R2 are annotated as ambiguous.

sentences: During the overnight shift, the reactor building air radiation monitor alarmed concurrently with the detection of a small primary coolant leakage rate increase on the sump level instrumentation.

The investigation team could not establish from the available timeline data whether the leakage had begun first and the radiation monitor alarm had followed as a consequence, or whether an unreported maintenance activity in the reactor building had stirred up settled radioactive particulate and triggered the alarm independently of the leakage increase.
All personnel who had been in the reactor building during the preceding four hours were interviewed and their activities logged as part of the source investigation.

cause.span: small primary coolant leakage rate increase

effect.span: reactor building air radiation monitor alarmed

cause.span: unreported maintenance activity in the reactor building had stirred up settled radioactive particulate

effect.span: reactor building air radiation monitor alarmed

annotation_notes: Two events are concurrent; causality direction and even causal connection are ambiguous. A third alternative cause (particulate disturbance from unreported activity) is introduced in S2. Models must represent all three possibilities without collapsing to a single relation.

sentences: The drop in reactor coolant system boron concentration and the rise in reactor power occurred within the same fifteen-minute window during the plant startup.

It was not possible from the startup data alone to determine whether the boron dilution had driven the power increase through a reduction in neutron absorption, or whether the power increase had resulted from a separate control rod movement that had subsequently caused some boron redistribution through coolant mixing.

Subsequent core physics modelling confirmed that the power increase had preceded the boron concentration change by approximately four minutes, establishing the control rod movement as the primary initiating cause.

cause.span: drop in reactor coolant system boron concentration

effect.span: rise in reactor power

cause.span: control rod movement

effect.span: rise in reactor power

annotation_notes: Ambiguity is explicitly stated in S2 then resolved in S3 using physics modelling. The resolution mechanism is temporal precedence (four-minute lead). Models must handle ambiguity-then-resolution narrative structure and update their relation validity accordingly.

sentences: The shift log records show that the high-temperature alarm on the main coolant pump motor activated at 14:23 and that the vibration alarm activated at 14:27, a four-minute sequence that was noted but not acted upon before the motor tripped at 14:41.

Post-trip analysis debated whether the temperature rise had been caused by friction from early bearing degradation — which would also explain the subsequent vibration — or whether a voltage imbalance had first caused localised winding heating, which in turn had thermally stressed the bearing and produced the secondary vibration.

Oil analysis from the bearing housing confirmed the presence of copper and iron wear particles consistent with bearing material, establishing bearing degradation as the initiating event rather than electrical heating.

effect.span: high-temperature alarm

Whether the increased corrosion product transport had loaded the resin faster and caused the capacity deterioration, or whether a change in coolant pH associated with the uprate had simultaneously degraded both the resin capacity and the corrosion product transport equilibrium through a shared mechanism, could not be determined from the operational data.
A dedicated chemistry study using isotopic tracers was initiated to discriminate between the two hypothesised mechanisms.
